## Historical audit

**Scope.** H0106 is a teacher-only review trace, not the underlying student trajectory. The inferred student goal was an Obsidian Linter automatic table-of-contents rule; the observed teacher goal was to assess hint use and implementation correctness. No scene is involved.

All citations below refer to source **H0106**, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane4/codex_parallel_08_lane4_I/reviews/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/round_1/teacher/trajs.json`. Character ranges identify the supplied complete observations, not unseen underlying student events.

| Evidence | Observation and limits |
|---|---|
| Teacher exploration | The teacher ran a repository/status and rule-integration search; its result showed `/app`, `NumberOptionBuilder`, and ignore-type integration references. It did not show the queried TOC files or any status changes in that output. [main_agent:event:1, chars 0–846; event:2, chars 0–1400] |
| Actual teacher output | The teacher wrote `/tmp/review_output.md`; the tool confirmed creation. The review and final response diagnose the student work and propose corrective guidance. This is a review artifact, not an observed change to the student implementation. [event:3, chars 0–7728; event:4, chars 0–7633; event:5, chars 0–7719] |
| Reported student changes | The teacher reports a TOC utility, rule adapter, English labels, protected-region checks and a custom-ignore guard. These are second-hand claims referencing student rounds 22, 23, 25 and 32; the actual student operations are not supplied here. [event:5, chars 0–7719] |
| Diagnosis and validation | The review quotes code that strips leading whitespace from the suffix and inserts newlines after the closing marker, and reports label-markup and ignore-type differences from a reference. It reports a successful build and 59 existing test suites, but no visible TOC-specific tests; the student reportedly described the command as stalled. These are teacher-reported observations, not an independent test in this trace. [event:5, chars 0–7719] |
| Hint and adoption | The teacher reports an earlier hint about infrastructure, separation, preservation and testing, and calls it partially used because student actions aligned with parts of it. The hint’s delivery and student receipt are not directly shown here; matching behavior alone does not establish adoption. The later corrective guidance is present in the review, but no subsequent student receipt or execution is visible. [event:5, chars 0–7719] |

**Outcome and uncertainty.** The teacher session formally completed successfully, and the review file was created [top_level_metadata, chars 0–11639; event:4, chars 0–7633]. The teacher diagnoses partial correctness and a concrete algorithmic boundary failure, but no independent evaluation result or student patch is provided in this record. A reported failed commit call does not establish that the implementation was empty or committed. Final student outcome remains unknown.

**Lessons and hypotheses.** Transferably, passing an existing suite does not demonstrate coverage of a new feature, and repeatability does not by itself establish preservation of surrounding content. Task-specific concerns are TOC marker suffixes, display-label markup and protected-region integration. Whether those differences fail the actual requirements, whether registration works, and whether any teacher guidance influenced later work remain unresolved in this teacher-only record.
